SELECT 
    customers.city,
    SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM 
    customers
JOIN 
    orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
    orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
group by 
    customers.city
order by 
    total_sales desc
limit 1;
